verdict: Numerically clean run that stopped at a 5-iteration Adam budget with a normalized gradient norm of 0.605, far from stationarity. The loss moved only 0.00077 (0.19009→0.18932). Residuals show systematic under-prediction (bias −0.926) and near-zero temporal correlation (0.042), but these are likely consequences of severe under-optimization rather than confirmed model mismatch. Parameters ka (0.196, range-fraction 0.146) and ke (0.464, range-fraction 0.833) sit near their respective bounds, which may reflect an unconverged iterate rather than a true boundary optimum.

recommendations.action: Increase gradient_opt.num_iters from 5 to at least 500 (or 2000 for safety) and run a gradient-only restart from this run. Keep the same model, bounds, and loss unchanged.
